explication: Envoy Gateway manages standalone or Kubernetes-based Envoy Proxy deployments. The principal workflow is: an operator submits Gateway API resources; a provider watches and assembles them; the Gateway API translator produces intermediate representations; xDS translation and infrastructure runners configure and provision Envoy; status is reported back. Configuration loading, extension hooks, global rate limiting, administration, and shutdown are supporting capabilities. The sampled excerpts directly establish runner orchestration and provider-to-translator channels; some downstream connections are inferred only where package responsibilities and comments explicitly support them.
